data_gaps.requested: A sampling-noise-free feedback ratio map (i.e. the twobound runs painted with the same generator noise as the fiducial)
data_gaps.why_blocked: No same-seed paired fiducial exists for the twobound suite. bind_science/runs/bind/run_0000 (== bind_lightcone_tng) is bit-identical to the LC fiducial but was painted independently of the twobound runs; the null-parameter twobound pair (run_0058/0059) shows a residual |log2 y ratio| of p50 = 0.124-0.131 / p90 = 0.32-0.33 relative to it, which is pure generator sampling noise. Regenerating a noise-paired fiducial would require re-running the painter (out of scope, and Slurm is forbidden here).
data_gaps.closest_alternative: Two mitigations, both zero-cost: (a) keep the ratio-to-fiducial construction and declare the noise floor in the LaTeX caption (per-pixel colour is ~1.3x the sampling floor; the mean shifts 0.936x / 1.076x are 13x / 5x the null pair's 0.995 / 0.986); (b) if a cleaner map is wanted, plot ONE panel of log2(y_high/y_low) (run_0001/run_0000), whose feedback contrast is 1.149 in the mean and whose common-mode noise partially cancels — but that costs the two-panel layout the user asked for.

data_gaps.requested: An honest (non-saturating) linear symmetric kappa bar with no extend arrow
data_gaps.why_blocked: Mathematically impossible: kappa is one-sided-heavy. A symmetric linear Normalize that covers the data needs vmax = kappa_max = 0.418 = 11.2 x vk0 = 22.8 sigma, at which point 99.97% of pixels fall inside +/-0.09 of a +/-0.42 bar and the sky renders as flat grey. Removing the arrow while keeping +/-2 sigma necessarily makes the top-end saturation silent (3.39% of BIND pixels, 3.62% of DMO pixels).
data_gaps.closest_alternative: Preferred: keep Normalize(-vk0, vk0), remove extend (or set extend='neither'), and move the saturation statement into the LaTeX caption (the user is deleting in-figure text, not caption text). Alternative if silent clipping is unacceptable: SymLogNorm(linthresh=vk0, linscale=1.0, vmin=-0.42, vmax=0.42, base=10) — verified to put zero exactly at the RdBu_r midpoint (norm(0) = 0.500), covers the full data range so extend='neither' is truthful, and keeps a near-linear core out to 2 sigma; it needs explicit cb.set_ticks([-0.03, 0, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3]) plus a FixedFormatter because the default symlog formatter blanks non-decade labels. Do NOT use AsinhNorm: norm(0) = 0.246, so zero would not be white.
